integrity.euler_basis: Compactly supported Euler characteristic localizes to the fixed locus for algebraic C* actions, and projectivity identifies it with ordinary Euler characteristic.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The zbMATH-linked MaRDI record for Catalano-Johnson gives publication date 1996-06-30.
integrity.fixed_point_basis: The scroll torus admits a generic one-parameter subgroup with pairwise distinct weights on all tautological coordinate monomials.
integrity.membership_basis: Projection to one directrix block reduces coordinate membership in a scroll secant to binary monomial border rank; catalecticants and finite differences give exact border rank min(j,d-j)+1.
integrity.object_basis: Catalano-Johnson and De Poi study the higher secant varieties of rational normal scrolls and determinantal descriptions of their ideals and dimensions.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The same record lists MSC 14N05 and 14N10, with projective techniques in algebraic geometry 14N05 first.

scientific_limitations: The theorem computes ordinary Euler characteristic only; it does not determine dimensions, defects, degrees, singularities, equations, or individual Betti numbers.
The statement is for the tautological embedding of smooth rational normal scrolls with all splitting degrees positive; conical zero-degree cases are excluded.
The fixed-point proof is short after reducing to binary monomial border rank, so an older unindexed or folklore formulation remains possible.
title: Euler characteristic of every secant variety of a smooth rational normal scroll
